ticket.subject: Question about invoice INV-2026-9980
ticket.body_text:
Good morning,

Writing on behalf of Saltmarsh Robotics. Our September invoice charges for 9 seats although we removed several users last month and now have 6.

We paid the invoice already so our books stay clean, but we expect a credit for the difference.

Please send a corrected invoice or a credit note.

Best regards,
Owen Esposito
project manager, Saltmarsh Robotics
